name: OpenEI Utility Rate Database
tagline: US utility electricity rate structures and tariffs via free OpenEI web services
description: OpenEI Utility Rate Database provides free web services for US utility electricity rate structures and tariffs, enabling developers to query rates by utility, location, or sector for energy analysis, solar modeling, and bill estimation.

auth.details: API key required via api_key query parameter; obtain free key from OpenEI

pricing.free_tier_limits: Default: 1,000 requests per hour per API key; service-specific limits may vary. DEMO_KEY: 30 requests per IP per hour and 50 per IP per day.

rate_limits: Default: 1,000 requests per hour per API key across api.data.gov APIs; service-specific limits may vary. DEMO_KEY: 30 per IP per hour and 50 per IP per day.
use_cases: get electricity rates for a US utility
look up rate structures by zip code
